curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Introduce the five seeing habits and lifelong learning.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on aim high, keep eyes moving, big picture, an out and being seen.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Questions on the safe driving habits.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain what defensive driving means and the attitudes behind it.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on defensive driving, courtesy and concentration.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach where to look ahead, at intersections and in the mirrors.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on eye lead, intersections, mirrors and blind spots.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain the two-second rule, when to add space, and how to handle tailgaters.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on following gaps and tailgaters.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover signaling and managing space around hazards and other road users.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on signals, splitting the difference and extra space.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain merge gaps, intersections, passing and handling others' mistakes.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on gaps, passing and merging drivers.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Scenario questions on merging and passing.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Define aggressive driving and how to avoid and respond to road rage.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on aggressive acts and road rage responses.

learning_path_rule.rule: module order sec14-m01..sec14-m07; component facts before the synthesis (R) nodes that contrast them; no dynamic nodes exist

one accepted C2 contrast fact joining the component facts it names

edge_types.definition: component fact must be learned before the contrast or dependent fact
